chose: Take picomatch 2.3.2, the 2.x security release for CVE-2026-33671 and CVE-2026-33672, in place of Dependabot's 4.0.7 (#3392, #3393). The detect-changes test (CD1) reproduces dorny/paths-filter v4.0.3's matching, and that action compiles patterns with picomatch ^2.3.1, so the test stays on the action's major; @types/picomatch stays 2.3.4. Revisit when a paths-filter release moves to picomatch 4.
options: picomatch 2.3.2, the same fix on the action's major (taken)
leave picomatch at 2.3.1 and dismiss the advisory as test-only
gray: Dependabot's security update and CD1's pin pull opposite ways: 4.0.7 clears the advisory but stops the test from modelling the matcher CI actually runs, and no check says which one wins.
undo: Set picomatch back to 2.3.1, or to 4.x with @types/picomatch 4.x, in packages/eslint/package.json and reinstall.
